note: Wright County Conservation Board campground on the north shore of 246-acre Lake Cornelia, northeast of Clarion. Sites 1-8 (electric only) line the lake shore; sites 9-26 ring the marina harbor; the rest are in loops along 175th Street at the north edge of the park, well back from the lake. Marina with day and overnight boat docking, beach, and a trail around the lake. --Claude
summary: Hookups (50A, water, sewer), 106 sites (was 88), facilities, season Apr 15-Oct 15 and FCFS-only booking confirmed from the county's mycountyparks page; lakefront confirmed for the 8 shore sites (official map, photos, imagery). Fees $25/$30 unchanged. Pin ~290 m off. Note rewritten (88 sites and year-round lakeshore camping were wrong).
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront confirmed for sites 1-8 only. The county's map draws them along the shore outside the harbor loop with the loop road behind (north of) them; the county's 'Campsites #1-8' photo and aerial show RVs on that gravel row with the open lake a few metres behind past grass, trees and rip-rap; imagery puts the pads ~5-15 m from the waterline with no road, trail or day use between. The 18 harbor sites (9-26) face the 1.5-acre marina basin, and the 80 north-loop sites are 350-450 m back. Evidence string: 'mycountyparks map + Campsites #1-8 photo + Esri at 42.7915,-93.6935: sites 1-8 on the lake shore, road behind'.

PIN: stored 42.79390,-93.69280 is by the park office buildings west of the harbor, ~290 m from the centre of the camping loops. Suggest ~42.7955,-93.6905 (between the north loops, which hold 80 of the 106 sites, and the harbor/shore rows).

NOTE CORRECTIONS: the stored note's '88 sites' (now 106) and 'lakeshore sites year-round with limited winter amenities' are contradicted by the county page ('106 Site Campground'; 'Winter camping is not available.').
FIT: no site lengths published; the county's photo of sites 1-8 shows a full-size Class A on the row. No caveat needed.
